title: 第11章 宗主想揍陆玄了第12章 少说话装高手
slug: 我的徒弟们都太逆天了
lines: “叮！宿主大徒弟姬扶摇灵火之力有所感悟！开始同步！”
陆玄心有所感，他缓缓摊开右手。
他直接踏入了灵火之道，圆满之境！
一缕柔和的灵火在他的掌心之中缓缓升起。
这灵火看似柔和，实则内部十分炽烈！
这就是圆满之境。
灵火之威内敛，收发由心，炽烈的力量归于“自然”。
陆玄收起灵火，换了个姿势躺着继续看书。
不得不说姬扶摇的天赋太强了！
他很期待，姬扶摇这段时间在火渊秘境修炼，他的修为和灵火感悟能增加到什么地步？
另一边。
火渊秘境之中，姬扶摇的灵火淬炼洗礼结束，她的收获很大。
她继续在第一层深入！
随着深入，火渊凝出的火兽越来越多，它们一个个面目狰狞，身上燃烧着炽烈火焰，仿若一座座小山横移而来。
每一个火兽的势力都堪比玄皇境修士！
这些火兽如同狼奔豕突，向着姬扶摇冲杀了过来。
姬扶摇纤纤玉手伸出，灵火之力涌动，直接拍了一下。
一大片火兽直接化为齑粉。
看到这一幕，众多弟子震惊了。
怎么可能这么轻松？
他们当年玄皇境的时候，杀一个火兽得费劲九牛二虎之力！
这一刻，她仿若火域的主宰，娇嫩唇瓣微启，“灭！”
如同言出法随。
姬扶摇所到之处，无数火兽纷纷化作灵火湮灭在空中。
如同秋风扫落叶一般，在姬扶摇面前，这些火兽没有一战之力！
一日后。
火渊秘境中一道苍老的声音响起。
“姬扶摇一日内击杀火兽数量突破只，创下新纪录！赐灵火淬炼洗礼！”
轰！
一道灵火长河垂落，璀璨道纹流转，将姬扶摇笼罩了进去。
见此，众多弟子内心掀起了滔天巨浪。
姬扶摇又破玄皇境记录了？
足足杀了一万多只火兽！
是之前记录创造者洛凌空的十倍不止！
什么时候火兽变得这么弱了？
他们马上将此事传音给自家圣人和宗主。
宗主等人无比震惊。
什么是天才？
这就是天才！
宗主有些惊喜，“不愧是引起了大道钟共鸣的妖孽！这等表现，即使放在我大道宗历史上也是名列前茅！”
剑峰圣人说道，“按照这个进度下去，扶摇很可能要在火渊之中突破玄宗境啊！”
嘶！
content_en:
"Ding! The host's great disciple Ji Fuyao has realized the power of spiritual fire! Start synchronization!"
Lu Xuan felt something in his heart and slowly spread his right hand.
He stepped directly into the path of spiritual fire, the state of perfection!
A soft spiritual fire slowly rose in his palm.
This spiritual fire looks gentle, but is actually very fiery inside!
This is the state of perfection.
The power of spiritual fire is restrained, sent and received by the heart, and its blazing power belongs to "nature".
Lu Xuan put away the spiritual fire, changed his posture, lay down and continued reading.
I have to say that Ji Fuyao's talent is too strong!
He was looking forward to seeing how far Ji Fuyao could increase his cultivation and spiritual fire perception during this period of time he was practicing in the Fire Abyss Secret Realm.
other side.
In the secret realm of the fire abyss, Ji Fuyao's spiritual fire tempering and baptism ended, and she gained a lot.
She continues deeper on the first level!
As it goes deeper, more and more fire beasts emerge from the fire abyss. Each of them has a ferocious appearance, and their bodies are burning with blazing flames, as if they are mountains moving sideways.
The power of each fire beast is comparable to that of a Xuanhuang Realm monk!
These fire beasts rushed toward Ji Fuyao like wolves and hogs.
Ji Fuyao stretched out her slender hand, and with the power of spiritual fire surging, she patted it directly.
"Boom!"
A large piece of fire beast turned directly into powder.
Seeing this scene, many disciples were shocked.
How could it be so easy?
When they were in the Xuanhuang realm, it would take a lot of effort to kill a fire beast!
At this moment, she was like the master of the fire realm, her delicate lips slightly opened, "Destroy!"
Just like the words are spoken, the law follows.
Wherever Ji Fuyao went, countless fire beasts turned into spiritual fire and were annihilated in the air.
Just like the autumn wind sweeping away fallen leaves, these fire beasts had no power to fight in front of Ji Fuyao!
One day later.
An old voice sounded in the secret realm of the Fire Abyss.
"Ji Fuyao has killed more than one fire beast in one day, setting a new record! Grant him tempering and baptism with spiritual fire!"
Boom!
A long river of spiritual fire fell down, and the bright patterns circulated, covering Ji Fuyao.
Seeing this, many disciples felt huge waves in their hearts.
Ji Fuyao broke the Xuanhuang realm record again?
More than 10,000 fire beasts were killed!
It is more than ten times that of the previous record creator Luo Lingkong!
When did the fire beast become so weak?
They immediately reported the matter to their saints and sect leaders.
The sect leader and others were extremely shocked.
What is a genius?
This is genius!
The sect leader was a little surprised, "He is indeed a monster that has resonated with the Dao Dao Bell! This kind of performance ranks among the best even in the history of our Dao Dao Sect!"
The Sword Peak Sage said, "If we continue at this rate, Fuyao will probably break through to the Xuanzong realm in the abyss of fire!"
Hiss!
title_en: Chapter 11: The sect leader wants to beat Lu Xuan Chapter 12: Talk less and pretend to be a master
